meta.name: L'Affaire Céline Giboire - une contre-enquête de McSkyz
meta.description: On February 28, 2012, the body of 16-year-old Céline Giboire was found at the foot of a cliff in the Corbières park in Saint-Malo. Since then, her family has rejected the suicide theory put forward by the authorities and has fought to uncover the truth about the circumstances of her death. McSkyz revisits the case in an attempt to understand what happened to Céline.
